questions.stem: A school has $600$ boys and $400$ girls. A stratified sample of $50$ students is to be taken. How many girls should be in the sample?
questions.explanation: In a stratified sample, each group is represented proportionally. Girls $= \frac{400}{1000} \times 50 = 20$.

questions.stem: What is the main advantage of a larger sample size?

options.text: It is more likely to be representative of the population

questions.explanation: A larger sample is more likely to be representative of the whole population, giving more reliable results. However, it does not automatically eliminate bias if the sampling method is flawed.
